name: The White Wolf
source:
A short visual novel made as a final degree project.

The White Wolf It's a recreation of the beginning of "[url=https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Witcher_3:_Wild_Hunt]The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt[/url]" developed by CD Projekt.

[Edited from [url=https://dearly-artist.itch.io/the-white-wolf]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“作为最终学位项目制作的一部简短的视觉小说。

《白狼》是对《白狼》开头的再现[url=https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Witcher_3:_Wild_Hunt]巫师3：狂猎[/url]” 由CD Projekt开发。

[编辑自[url=https://dearly-artist.itch.io/the-white-wolf]痒痒io[/url]]
